median_views.x-description-zh: 创作者近期视频播放量的中位数。

engagement_rate.title: Engagement Rate
engagement_rate.description: Engagements divided by views, as a fraction from 0 to 1.
engagement_rate.x-description-zh: 互动数除以播放数，取值 0 到 1 的小数。

followers_growth_rate.title: Followers Growth Rate

followers_growth_rate.x-description-zh: 近期粉丝增长率，以小数表示。

six_second_view_rate.title: Six Second View Rate
six_second_view_rate.description: Share of views that lasted at least six seconds, from 0 to 1.
six_second_view_rate.x-description-zh: 观看时长达到 6 秒的播放占比，取值 0 到 1。

label.title: Label

label.x-description-zh: 分组名称，例如年龄段、性别或设备品牌。

share.title: Share
share.description: Share of the total, from 0 to 1.
